title: Meta Ads for Real Estate in India: Facebook Ads That Bring Site Visits
seoTitle: Meta Ads for Real Estate in India (2026): Setup & Lead Forms
excerpt: Meta (Facebook) ads for real estate in India: campaign types, housing ad rules, targeting, lead forms that filter junk, creatives, cost and setup steps.

faqs.question: Do Facebook ads work for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for new launches, EOI drives, NRI buyers and retargeting, because Meta reaches people before they search. They work poorly when judged only on cost per lead, since instant forms also attract curious scrollers. Judge them on site visits recorded in your CRM, and follow up every lead within minutes.

faqs.question: Are Meta ads and Facebook ads the same thing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Meta is the company that owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and one Ads Manager account runs ads across Facebook and Instagram, including click-to-WhatsApp ads. People search for both names, but the campaign setup, targeting and lead forms are the same whichever name you use.

faqs.question: Does Meta's Special Ad Category for housing apply in India?
faqs.answer: Only if your ads reach the US, Canada or Europe, according to Meta's documentation. Ads shown only in India may opt in or out. NRI campaigns reaching those regions must declare housing, which fixes age at 18 to 65+, removes gender and lookalike targeting and requires broader locations.

faqs.question: How do I get better quality leads from Facebook ads?
faqs.answer: Use the higher-intent form type, show the price band on the intro screen, ask two or three qualifying questions, reply on WhatsApp at once, and send qualified-lead and site-visit stages back to Meta through the Conversions API for CRM, so it optimises for conversion leads instead of form fills.

faqs.question: Should I use lead forms or send people to a landing page?
faqs.answer: Lead forms produce more leads with less effort; a landing page produces fewer, better-informed ones. Many projects use forms for launches and a landing page for retargeting and higher-intent buyers. Compare both on cost per site visit from your CRM, not on cost per lead in Ads Manager.

faqs.question: How much do Facebook ads cost for real estate in India?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed price, because Meta runs an auction and costs depend on city, audience, season, creative and form type. We have not found a sourced public benchmark for Indian real estate. Run a test for a few weeks and calculate spend divided by leads, qualified leads and site visits.

faqs.question: Do click-to-WhatsApp ads work for property?
faqs.answer: They can, because Indian buyers are comfortable chatting on WhatsApp. They only work if a person or a bot replies at once, day and night, sends the brochure and price sheet, asks the qualifying questions and offers site-visit slots. Slow replies waste the click you paid for.

faqs.question: What creatives work best for real estate on Instagram and Facebook?
faqs.answer: Short walkthrough reels from the sample flat, commute videos from the nearest metro or expressway, price-band statics, floor plan carousels and monthly construction progress. Each must show the RERA registration number and state RERA website, plus the QR code in states such as UP that require it.

faqs.question: What should I ask a real estate Facebook ads agency?
faqs.answer: Ask whether the ad account and Pixel stay in your name, whether they report site visits and bookings by campaign, how fast leads are contacted, and how they handle RERA details and the Special Ad Category. Be wary of anyone guaranteeing a lead count or cost per lead in advance.
